content.text: In Mikop22/securitydemo, CVE-2026-2699 allows unauthenticated access to restricted ShareFile SZC configuration pages. Update gateway/szc_config_guard.py so unauthenticated requests to restricted prefixes (including path traversal) raise UnauthorizedConfigAccessError and check_gateway_fix.py exits 0.
Normalized request paths with posixpath.normpath and enforced authenticated_admin on restricted SZC configuration prefixes in gateway/szc_config_guard.py. Verified check_gateway_fix.py exits 0.
